channel.title: The Kimberley Echo - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Kimberley Echo (kimberleyecho.com.au)

item.title: Banned drinkers register made permanent in Pilbara and Kimberley after successful NW trial
item.description: After a five-year trial, the banned drinkers register has now become permanent in the Pilbara and Kimberley.

item.title: Kimberley police put sly grogging in their sights as liquor reforms pass Parliament
item.description: Police are targeting sly groggers in the Kimberley with improved technology and intelligence gathering resulting in more would-be illegal liquor sales being intercepted before they hit the streets.

item.title: WA road toll: Deaths on the roads lower in 2025 than 2024 as Australian toll soars
item.description: The death toll on WA roads was at odds with the national trend seen across the country in 2025.

item.title: Fitzroy Crossing renal health centre $9 million expansion complete
item.description: The Fitzroy Crossing renal health centre has officially reached practical completion after a $9 million expansion.

item.title: Teen charged with arson following Jasmine Lane Group Home fire in Kununurra
item.description: A 15-year-old boy has been charged with arson after it’s claimed he sparked a fire at Jasmine Lane Group Home in Kununurra on Boxing Day.

item.title: Wyndham meetings back on agenda for Shire of Wyndham East Kimberley
item.description: The Shire of Wyndham East Kimberley could be back in Wyndham by the end of this year.

item.title: North West AFL grand finalists Callum Ah Chee and Lawson Humphries to star in upcoming AFL Origin match
item.description: North West AFL stars Callum Ah Chee and Lawson Humphries have joined the WA squad for the upcoming AFL Origin match against Victoria at Optus Stadium on February 14.

item.title: Film explores healing after Kimberley floods
item.description: A short film exploring cultural healing after the devastating 2023 Kimberley floods has screened in Broome.

item.title: $5 million grant announced for key worker homes in Fitzroy Crossing
item.description: The State Government will spend $5 million to support key worker housing in Fitzroy Crossing.

item.title: Perth & WA Weather: Scorching heatwave set to sizzle through parts of WA
item.description: Temperatures exceeded 40C over several days in parts of the Pilbara last week, with temperatures at Onslow Airport reaching 49C on January 7 the highest temperature recorded anywhere in the world on that day.
